title: flutter_packages — twelve Dart and Flutter packages
description: Source for twelve Dart and Flutter packages published to pub.dev under the jumyn.com publisher, each scoring 160/160 pub points: woo_client, loading_kit, fit_text, masonry_kit, anchored_list, vitals, roomplan, ar_quick_look, cross_tab, file_system_access, apple_foundation_models and apple_intelligence. Every package is MIT licensed and carries its own LICENSE file.
